Callout.Name: Theft in Progress
Callout.Message: Person filling a bag with stock and walking out.
Callout.Advisory: Staff following at a distance, no violence.

Script.Line: I was taking it back. That is what I was doing, taking it back.
The bag is full because I had not put it down yet.
I have not left the shop. I am still inside the shop.

Lines.Approach: They are following him at a distance. No violence so far - keep it that way.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
